post.summary: Publish a deal.won for a tenant under an identifier the caller may choose; a platform operator only, and served only when dealfeed.enabled is true
post.description: Hands the deal.won consumers what the deals module never publishes: one identifier twice, one identifier in two tenants, and a tenant the consumers do not serve. The payload is the deal event contract's, with object, outcome and won_at filled here. The tenant is not checked against the roster: the consumers refuse a disabled or unknown tenant themselves. dealfeed.enabled is false unless a deployment sets it, and this fragment is declared whatever it says, so a deployment that leaves it off lists this operation without serving it.
